notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Coercive Recruiter.
Coercive Recruiter does not have summoning sickness.
"Pirate" chosen with Conspiracy.
description:
Activate Coercive Recruiter by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
When the Elf Warrior enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Conspiracy, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Coercive Recruiter.
Repeat.
